question: где проверяется пароль пользователя при входе?
facts: crud.authenticate is called on login and checks the password
it calls security.verify_password, which uses password_hash.verify_and_update from pwdlib

question: how is the JWT access token created?
facts: create_access_token in security.py builds a payload with exp and sub
it is signed with jwt.encode using settings.SECRET_KEY and the HS256 algorithm

question: как определяется текущий пользователь по токену?
facts: get_current_user in deps.py decodes the JWT with SECRET_KEY
loads the user by the sub claim from the database
403 if the token is invalid, 404 if user not found, 400 if user is inactive

question: where is the login endpoint?
facts: POST /login/access-token handled by login_access_token in routes/login.py
takes an OAuth2 password form, calls crud.authenticate and returns an access token

question: как пароль хэшируется перед сохранением?
facts: get_password_hash calls password_hash.hash (pwdlib, Argon2 as the primary hasher)
crud.create_user stores the result in hashed_password

question: how does password recovery by email work?
facts: POST /password-recovery/{email} generates a reset JWT and emails a link with the token
the response is the same whether or not the email exists
POST /reset-password/ verifies the token and updates the password

question: где проверяется, что пользователь администратор?
facts: get_current_active_superuser in deps.py checks current_user.is_superuser
raises 403 "The user doesn't have enough privileges" otherwise

question: how are emails sent?
facts: send_email in utils.py sends the message over SMTP with the emails library
SMTP host, port, TLS/SSL, user and password come from settings
it asserts that emails are enabled

question: как создаётся первый суперпользователь при запуске?
facts: init_db in core/db.py looks up FIRST_SUPERUSER by email
if missing it creates the user with FIRST_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD and is_superuser=True via crud.create_user

question: how does a user sign up without being logged in?
facts: POST /users/signup handled by register_user
returns 400 if the email already exists
creates the user with crud.create_user

question: где удаляется item?
facts: DELETE /items/{id} handled by delete_item in routes/items.py
404 if not found, 403 if the user is neither the owner nor a superuser

question: how is the database session created for each request?
facts: get_db in deps.py opens Session(engine) and yields it
injected into endpoints through SessionDep

question: как пользователь меняет свой пароль?
facts: PATCH /users/me/password handled by update_password_me

question: where is the health check endpoint?
facts: GET /utils/health-check/ handled by health_check, returns True

question: где описана таблица пользователей в базе данных?
facts: class User in models.py with table=True
fields include id (UUID), hashed_password, created_at and an items relationship; email and flags come from UserBase

question: how long is a login access token valid?
facts: ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES defaults to 60*24*8 minutes, i.e. 8 days
login_access_token uses it as the token expiration

question: какой алгоритм используется для подписи JWT?
facts: ALGORITHM = "HS256" in security.py
tokens are signed with settings.SECRET_KEY

question: which password hashing algorithms are supported?
facts: password_hash is a pwdlib PasswordHash with Argon2Hasher and BcryptHasher
Argon2 is first, so it is used for new hashes; bcrypt hashes can still be verified

question: что происходит со старым bcrypt-хэшем пароля при входе?
facts: verify_password returns (verified, updated_hash) via verify_and_update
if an updated hash is returned, authenticate saves it to db_user.hashed_password, so the password is rehashed (to Argon2)

question: how does authenticate protect against timing attacks?
facts: if the user does not exist, authenticate still runs verify_password against DUMMY_HASH
so response time is similar whether or not the email exists

question: может ли обычный пользователь удалить чужой item?
facts: no: delete_item raises 403 "Not enough permissions" if the user is not the owner and not a superuser

question: what items does a regular user see when listing items?
facts: regular users see only items where owner_id equals their id
superusers see all items
results are ordered by created_at descending with skip/limit

question: может ли суперпользователь удалить сам себя?
facts: no: both delete_user_me and delete_user return 403 "Super users are not allowed to delete themselves"

question: what happens to a user's items when an admin deletes the user?
facts: delete_user first deletes all Item rows with owner_id equal to the user id, then deletes the user

question: что проверяется при смене своего пароля?
facts: the current password is verified with verify_password, otherwise 400 "Incorrect password"
the new password must differ from the current one, otherwise 400
the new password is hashed with get_password_hash and saved

question: which endpoint returns the current user's profile?
facts: GET /users/me handled by read_user_me, returns current_user

question: когда отправляется письмо о создании нового аккаунта?
facts: when a superuser creates a user via POST /users/ and settings.emails_enabled is true
the email is built by generate_new_account_email and includes the username and password

question: when are emails considered enabled?
facts: emails_enabled is true only when SMTP_HOST and EMAILS_FROM_EMAIL are both set

question: что будет, если оставить SECRET_KEY равным changethis?
facts: in development (FASTAPI_ENV == "development") only a warning is shown
otherwise a ValueError is raised
the same check applies to the database password and FIRST_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD

question: how is the database URL adapted for the postgres driver?
facts: postgres:// and postgresql:// prefixes are replaced with postgresql+psycopg://

question: где подключаются все роутеры API?
facts: api/main.py creates api_router and includes the login, users, utils and items routers
the private router is included only in development
app/main.py mounts api_router under API_V1_STR

question: when is the private users endpoint available?
facts: the private router is included only when FASTAPI_ENV == "development"
POST /private/users/ creates a user without authentication

question: как настроен CORS?
facts: CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=[settings.FRONTEND_HOST]
allow_credentials=True, all methods and headers allowed

question: how long is a password reset token valid?
facts: validity is EMAIL_RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRE_HOURS, default 48 hours
used to set exp in generate_password_reset_token

question: где рендерятся HTML-шаблоны писем?
facts: render_email_template in utils.py reads a file from the email-templates folder and renders it with a Jinja Template

question: how is Stripe payment processing implemented?
facts: there is no payment or Stripe code in the repository

question: где реализована загрузка файлов в S3?
facts: there is no file upload or S3 code in the repository

question: how does the app cache responses in Redis?
facts: there is no Redis or response caching in the repository

question: как работает вход через Google?
facts: there is no Google / social login; only email and password login exists

question: where is rate limiting for the login endpoint configured?
facts: there is no rate limiting in the repository
